title: Audio stream buffered append
summary: Recovered VA 0x58e250 (RVA 0x18e250), 73 bytes, as AudioStream::append_buffer. Calls the existing append dependency on stream+0x6d7c, returns zero on success, and normalizes any nonzero result to -1 without rolling back helper side effects. Failure logging is suppressed by byte flag 0x20 at +0x6dac; otherwise the original diagnostic uses line 769 and return -1. Direct Game.exe disassembly and three callers confirm optimized ECX=this, EDX=source, caller-cleaned stack count. The portable member interface preserves behavior rather than this optimized ABI. Dependencies remain explicit integration points.
test_description: Local freestanding GCC i386 fixed-flag test passed 4608 direct-original comparisons: all 256 flag bytes, two existing-tail fill states, and counts INT_MIN,-1,0,1,2,6,7,16,INT_MAX. Null source used for nonpositive counts. Controlled allocator always fails when allocation is reached, verifying both immediate and partial-copy failure; 2048 cases exercise failure. Checks return, full stream including opaque fields, entire node and guarded storage, source immutability, exact copy extent, total length, diagnostic count and original format address/line/result/stderr offset, allocation count, and original FS head restoration. A further 1280 dependency-contract assertions exercise positive and negative nonzero helper results and every flag byte. Helper adapter binds the accepted original append rather than implementing it. Exact 4-byte .test_iat binds memcpy. For full-path local testing an additional 28-byte .audio_imports is mapped at 0x92d38c; without that mapping the harness explicitly reports the limitation and still passes 2560 success-path original comparisons plus all contract assertions. Test-owned FS backing is initialized and successful installation is mandatory. Local linked oracle spans were compared exactly with immutable Game.exe: 73,268,6 bytes. Supplied VS2013 compiler accepted implementation under O1, O2, and O2 /Oy-; this is compilation evidence only, with no matching claim.
known_limits: Full failure-path original comparisons require the additional .audio_imports fixture at 0x92d38c (28 bytes: fprintf, __iob_func, two unused words, malloc, unused word, free). If the trusted linker does not map this section, those 2048 cases are explicitly skipped; they passed the local fixed-address link.

Existing audio-buffer-append remains an external member dependency. Its allocation, free-list management and copying implementation is not recovered in this bounded task. Tests cover existing-tail success and failing allocation, not successful heap allocation or free-list reuse.
Diagnostic port integration remains an explicit external function. Tests validate arguments and call suppression; they do not validate Windows CRT FILE internals or actual console output.
Invalid positive-count source pointers, malformed chunk structures, exceptions and concurrent mutation are outside controlled tests. Original wrapper performs no argument validation or rollback.

Portable member ABI differs from the original optimized register/caller-cleanup ABI. GCC-only regparm(3) declarations are isolated in test.cpp to call originals without assembly. No matching-byte credit is claimed.
